hooks.command: for p in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python" python3 python py; do if "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/capture_session.py" 2>>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook_errors.log"; exit 0; fi; done; echo "capture_session: no Python 3.8+ found (tried .venv, python3, python, py)" >>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook_errors.log"; exit 0

for p in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python" python3 python py; do if "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/push_session.py" 2>>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook_errors.log"; exit 0; fi; done; echo "push_session: no Python 3.8+ found (tried .venv, python3, python, py)" >>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook_errors.log"; exit 0
